description.short: Upload property listings, news, and name cards for OCR + Odoo sync.
description.full: Internal document ingest assistant for the Century 21 Hong Kong team. Send a property listing PDF/image, a news article, or a name card in a 1:1 chat and it runs OCR, classification, and extraction, then syncs the result to Odoo. Same assistant already available via WhatsApp and Slack ("Document Assistant") - this is the Teams channel. Not a property search tool - document upload only.
